title: OutcomeRecord
description: A real-world result that arrives AFTER the decision it judges, and that can overturn the checker. Carries reality authority. It must name the decision it belongs to, because a reality grade that cannot be linked back to a decision is an unattributable claim rather than evidence.

outcome_id.description: Stable. Replaying the same outcome_id MUST NOT record a second grade.

decision_id.description: The decision this outcome judges. Required: an unlinked outcome is discarded rather than counted, since Gradebook's reality grades are defined by their span link back to the decision.

provider_response_id.description: Secondary correlation key, used when the emitter needs to resolve a decision whose span reference is no longer held in memory.

outcome_type.description: What kind of real-world result this is, e.g. pull_request_merged, change_reverted, deployment_survived_window. Free-form: the set of things reality can say is open-ended.

correct.description: Whether reality agreed with the decision. Strictly boolean: a JSON number MUST be rejected rather than coerced, because a truthy 1 silently becoming a passing grade is a known way to corrupt a headline metric.

observed_at.description: When the outcome was observed, RFC 3339. This is the observation time and NOT the decision time; the gap between them is the whole point of a deferred grade.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to what makes this outcome checkable by a third party, e.g. a pull request URL or a record id.

explanation.description: Human-readable reason, carried through to the standard gen_ai.evaluation.explanation attribute.

ext.description: Reserved forward-compatibility namespace, the only place unknown fields are permitted.
